description: Replying to @Lexi 🐳🩵  We owe it to ourselves fo open the gifts that are waiting for us 🎁 #careeradvice #careershift #lifebydesign
transcript: There is so much fear in the unknown, which is valid. But if we allow the external world to continue to scare us, we don't allow the internal world to show us courage. And within that, anytime we show courage, the external world has no choice but to present us with the things that are owed to us.
